title: Amount Due, Part Payment and Overpayment Terms in Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay
content:
Under Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay, whether a bill's amount due is looked up from the biller before payment, whether less than the amount due may be paid, and whether more than the amount due may be paid are set product by product.

| Product | Amount due looked up from the biller before payment | Less than the amount due may be paid | More than the amount due may be paid |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | no | no | no |
| Paloma Data Bundle | no | no | no |
| Paloma Electricity Token | no | no | no |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | yes | yes | no |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | yes | no | no |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | no | yes | no |

## The terms restated

- **Overpayment.** No product of Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay allows more than a bill's amount due to be paid.
- **Look-up.** For Paloma Bill Pay Utilities and Paloma Bill Pay Television, the amount due is fetched from the biller before the payment is taken.
- **Part payment.** Paloma Bill Pay Utilities and Paloma Bill Pay School Fees allow a payment of less than the amount due; Paloma Bill Pay Television does not.

## Basis questions

**Can a Paloma Bill Pay Utilities customer pay part of a bill?** Yes. The amount due is looked up from the biller first, and a lower payment is accepted because part payment is allowed for this product; a payment above the amount due is not accepted.

**Can a Paloma Bill Pay Television customer pay less than the amount the biller shows as due?** No. The amount due is looked up first, and Paloma Bill Pay Television allows neither part payment nor overpayment.

**Is a Paloma Bill Pay School Fees amount looked up from the biller?** No. The amount due is not looked up for Paloma Bill Pay School Fees; the product allows part payment and does not allow overpayment.
